Pengana Global Private Credit Trust has cancelled 917,807 fully paid ordinary units on the ASX under an equal access scheme buy-back, effective September 22, 2026. The reduction in issued capital may enhance value per remaining unit and adjust the trust’s capital structure, potentially affecting liquidity and portfolio management for existing investors.

The buy-back signals active capital management by the trust’s responsible entity, reflecting a willingness to return capital or consolidate the register where appropriate. For stakeholders, this move can alter ownership dynamics while underscoring the trust’s focus on optimising its funding base in the competitive private credit investment market.

More about Pengana Global Private Credit Trust

Pengana Global Private Credit Trust is an ASX-listed investment vehicle focused on global private credit markets. The trust offers investors exposure to diversified portfolios of private credit assets through its ordinary units, targeting income and risk-adjusted returns from non-public debt instruments.
